My health concerns, including general and ongoing healthcare issues, have not been taken seriously, and I have felt consistently unsupported. In my opinion, a significant proportion of the doctors at this practice fall well below the standard expected of a healthcare provider. I have been registered with this surgery for almost seven years and, until recently, had not raised any formal complaints. However, after repeated negative experiences, I feel compelled to speak out. I would strongly encourage the surgery to reflect seriously on patient care, staff conduct, and communication standards.
